The '''star''' is the in-game currency of Polytopia. It is used for training [[units]], buying [[Technology|technologies]], harvesting resources and constructing [[buildings]]. 

Stars are produced every turn by [[cities]] and buildings like the [[Market]]. This income is measured in stars per turn (SPT) and is shown in brackets next to the current amount of stars. One-time sources of stars can also be obtained from various methods, outlined below.

[[File:Hoodrick world.PNG|thumb|A 2016 screenshot in which the in-game currency is called "resources."]]

Stars were originally called "'''resources'''." They still represent resources in the Polytopian world.<ref>{{Cite social media|author=Zoythrus|website=Discord|date=2 October 2019|link=https://discord.com/channels/283436219780825088/561211722296197120/629194653551427584}}</ref>
